subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should Gateway use when a configured channel plugin fails before it registers a channel runtime?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested remedies cross product policy: fail-fast startup, warn-and-continue audit logging, hot plugin reload, and process-stable metadata caching have different compatibility and operator-impact tradeoffs.

options.title: Warn-And-Continue Channel Audit
options.body: Emit a startup summary that includes configured channel ids attempted, loaded, and failed before registration while preserving Gateway startup for unaffected channels.

options.title: Fail Fast For Configured Channel Mismatch
options.body: Treat incompatible or missing configured channel plugin runtimes as startup-blocking errors, accepting that existing operators may see upgrades fail closed.

options.title: Split Broad Requests First
options.body: Track hot reload and performance caching separately, then keep this issue focused only on pre-registration channel diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Warn-And-Continue Channel Audit
recommendation.body: Emit a startup summary that includes configured channel ids attempted, loaded, and failed before registration while preserving Gateway startup for unaffected channels.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line provenance and adjacent loader/startup history make this the best available owner for choosing the Gateway/plugin startup contract.
